# Meon Valley Web

> Web design, WordPress hosting and maintenance for small businesses in Hampshire and on the South Coast, UK.

Meon Valley Web builds fast, mobile-friendly websites (WordPress and Astro) and provides managed WordPress hosting with daily backups, Cloudflare DNS, free SSL and UK business-hours support. Services also include ongoing WordPress support and maintenance, and a WordPress Doctor rescue service for hacked, broken or slow sites.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://meonvalleyweb.com/services): Custom WordPress, Astro and headless website builds.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://meonvalleyweb.com/hosting): Managed hosting plans with pricing, daily backups and migration.
- [WordPress Support](https://meonvalleyweb.com/wordpress-support-south-coast): Ongoing maintenance and care plans.
- [WordPress Doctor](https://meonvalleyweb.com/wordpress-doctor): Emergency fixes for hacked, broken or slow WordPress sites.

- [About](https://meonvalleyweb.com/about): Background on Meon Valley Web.
